cost_definitions.cumulative_prompt: Sum of actual query-time LM prompt tokens, including first pass and any revision/selector/extraction
cost_definitions.embeddings: Reusable sentence index/preprocessing separated from online query embedding and ranking; cache hits retain conceptual origin cost
cost_definitions.end_to_end: Only separately measured wall-clock interval; never sum stage estimates or fill missing with zero
cost_definitions.final_prompt: Actual final answer-generation prompt tokens, including retained canonical SARA context
cost_definitions.verifier: Every query pays D0 + E3 + F0, even KEEP; verifier time additional, no refunds

method_config.generator_context: Canonical first-pass SARA latent context retained; frozen F messages appended inside original chat envelope
method_config.initial_pass_precision: Historical original SARA BF16, as saved W7/W8 first passes; frozen FP16 E3/F revision unchanged
method_config.sentence_presentation: Restore original document order, exact source substrings
method_config.sentence_ranking: Query-only cosine; frozen E3 rank/tie/source presentation logic
method_config.verify: E3-k3 + F0 + G2 logistic; KEEP_D0 vs ACCEPT_THIS_F0

controller_configuration.DAFiR2: not evaluated; requires sequential counterfactual outcomes
controller_configuration.E4_reason: no demonstrated attribution benefit in tested variants
controller_configuration.family_rows_note: Per-family cost-efficient operating points; the overall selected point is chosen once from the full grid and replaces its family row.

E0.latency_note: Cached k4 generation + selected W8-A promotion + measured attribution extraction when required; excludes other unmeasured routing, gate, and selector overhead. Not measured end-to-end deployment latency.

controller_configuration.gate: B0-GW logistic: measured token U1-U12; weight=1+5*max(0,best_delta)
controller_configuration.gate_training: 5-fold paper-grouped FIT OOF; full FIT refit
controller_configuration.selection_rule: highest FIT OOF downstream F1; within .003 lower cumulative prompt tokens, then recorded generation/attribution latency estimate, then simplicity
controller_configuration.token_accounting: Exact tokenizer input_ids lengths, including chat template and special tokens; both passes counted for promotions

method_config.reference: Original W8 final-system protocol, not the W8-E cached replay; actual token uncertainty and frozen gate/selector
